feedback: The test cases directly and clearly exercise the requirement to evaluate operators of equal precedence from left to right. Test R006-T01 (10 - 5 - 3) validates left-to-right evaluation for subtraction, ensuring (10 - 5) - 3 = 2, not 10 - (5 - 3) = 8. Test R006-T03 (2 + 3 + 4) validates left-to-right evaluation for addition, ensuring (2 + 3) + 4 = 9. Both cases are simple, unambiguous, and directly target the specified behavior. The justifications are accurate and aligned with the customer intent. No additional tests are needed to cover this requirement, as the provided cases fully capture the left-to-right evaluation for operators of equal precedence. Mathematical reference checks are not required here as the behavior is deterministic and well-defined by the requirement.
